name: Karen Voluptas
original_name: カレン・ウォルプタス
source:
Karen is a proud goddess of love. Falling in love with a human is beneath her. After she realizes she's been struck by her own love arrow she works on a cure but [url=https://vndb.org/c68216]Keisuke's[/url] kindness toward her and her overwhelming feelings of love for him make it difficult to concentrate sometimes.

Her name is based on [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voluptas]Voluptas[/url], daughter of Cupid and Psyche.
